entry.title: Ziegler's conjecture for r-stable Kneser hypergraphs
entry.statement:
Let $KG^r(n,k)$ be the Kneser hypergraph whose vertices are the $k$-element subsets of $[n]$, and call a subset $S\subseteq[n]$ **$r$-stable** when any two elements $x,y\in S$ satisfy $r\leq |x-y|\leq n-r$. Let $KG^r(n,k)_{r\text{-}\mathrm{Stab}}$ be the sub-hypergraph induced by the $r$-stable vertices. **Ziegler's conjecture.** For all $n\geq rk$ and $r\geq2$, its chromatic number is

$$
\chi\bigl(KG^r(n,k)_{r\text{-}\mathrm{Stab}}\bigr)=\left\lceil\frac{n-r(k-1)}{r-1}\right\rceil.
$$

This asserts that the Alon–Frankl–Lovász chromatic-number formula remains valid after restricting to $r$-stable vertices. The source attributes the conjecture to Ziegler; no resolution status is supplied here.
entry.source_name: Yufeng Shen, Zhiyu Song, Feneglin Yu, Leopold Wuhan Zhou and Jingqi Zhuang, “Neighborhood Complexes of induced k-independent graphs”, arXiv:2512.09674 (2025).
entry.references:
**4 papers in this index state this conjecture** (2009–2025). The statement above is taken from the most recent of them; the others are [arXiv:2509.22026](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.22026), [arXiv:1712.03456](https://arxiv.org/abs/1712.03456), [arXiv:0912.4748](https://arxiv.org/abs/0912.4748).

Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.09674

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of December 2025).

entry.title: Bhanja–Kom–Pandey lower-bound and inverse conjecture for positive restricted signed sumsets

full_record.title: Bhanja–Kom–Pandey lower-bound and inverse conjecture for positive restricted signed sumsets
full_record.statement:
Let $A$ be a set of $k\geq 4$ positive integers, and let $h$ be an integer with $3\leq h\leq k-1$. The restricted signed $h$-fold sumset is denoted by $h^{\wedge}_{\pm}A$. **Bhanja–Kom–Pandey's conjecture.** One should have

$$
\left|h^{\wedge}_{\pm}A\right|\geq 2hk-h^2+1.
$$

This lower bound is best possible. Moreover, if equality holds, then

$$
A=d\ast\{1,3,\ldots,2k-1\}
$$

for some positive integer $d$. The conjecture gives the expected lower bound and equality case for positive-integer restricted signed sumsets; the source states that the case $h=3$ was proved, while the general range remains conjectural.
full_record.source_name: Raj Kumar Mistri and Nitesh Prajapati, “Direct and Inverse Problems for Restricted Signed Sumsets – II”, arXiv:2504.09617 (2025).
full_record.references:
**2 papers in this index state this conjecture** (2024–2025). The statement above is taken from the most recent of them; the others are [arXiv:2403.03625](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.03625).

Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.09617

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of April 2025).
